_comment: Hand-authored. Bank 2: the scene after corridor 21, the status cursor, the ending (836-B04). The generators subtract these.

regions.name: SCENE AFTER CORRIDOR 21 (bank 2 `$8836`, slot `$801B`): picture on
regions.description: `JSR $C063` (`$EDF4`: vblank sync, NMI and rendering on). The scene is the 'planet with an alien core' of the ending entry: a ship flying up past a planet that blows up and dissolves.

regions.name: SCENE AFTER CORRIDOR 21 (bank 2 `$8836`, slot `$801B`): the ship's fields
regions.description: Slot 0: y target `$0668` := 0, `$0680`, `$06C8`, y fraction `$05C0` := 0, `$0620` := 1, y speed `$05D8` := 1 (down), and X := 1 with `JSR $C0A2` (`$CD99`: clears slot 1's phase counters).

regions.name: SCENE AFTER CORRIDOR 21 (bank 2 `$8836`, slot `$801B`): the ship
regions.description: Type 5 (the corridor ship), y `$B0`, x `$80`, metasprite `$0D`.

regions.name: SCENE AFTER CORRIDOR 21 (bank 2 `$8836`, slot `$801B`): one pass
regions.description: `LDY #1 / JSR $C021` (wait a frame), `JSR $C01E` (`$D64C`: read the pads), `JSR $C096` (`$CDB4`: start the frame's sprites).

regions.name: SCENE AFTER CORRIDOR 21 (bank 2 `$8836`, slot `$801B`): the phase
regions.description: `JSR $C0A5` (`$CD7A`) with A = `$40`, Y = `$F0`: **`$0650` += `$40` each pass and the phase `$0638` steps when it carries, i.e. every fourth pass, up to `$F0`**; Y = the phase. RUN: about 7 frames to a phase (the loop's frame wait plus the object loop), 754 frames in all.

regions.name: SCENE AFTER CORRIDOR 21 (bank 2 `$8836`, slot `$801B`): phase `$00-$0F`
regions.description: The y spring (`$C09C`, acceleration 8/256) toward y 0: the ship, moving down at 1 px a frame, slows, stops (y 191 at phase 8) and rises.

regions.name: SCENE AFTER CORRIDOR 21 (bank 2 `$8836`, slot `$801B`): phase `$10-$1F`
regions.description: Target `$0668` := `$FF` and acceleration 2: a faint downward pull while it climbs (RUN: y 175 at phase `$10`, 148 at `$18`).

regions.name: SCENE AFTER CORRIDOR 21 (bank 2 `$8836`, slot `$801B`): phase `$20-$3F`: the ship turns away
regions.description: The metasprite `$0548` := `$88A6[(phase - $20) / 4]` = `0D 0C 0C 0B 0A 09 08 01`: eight pictures, ending on the small one `$01` (RUN: `$0D` until phase `$20`, `$0C` at `$28`, `$0A` at `$30`, `$08` at `$38`, `$01` from `$3F`).

regions.name: Scene after corridor 21: the ship's pictures
regions.description: `0D 0C 0C 0B 0A 09 08 01`: metasprites by (phase - `$20`) / 4.

regions.name: Scene after corridor 21: the dissolve order
regions.description: `02 16 1E 15 03 19 0F 13 1F 07 01 17 0B 1B 14 12 1D 0C 0D 05 1A 10 06 09 00 0A 0E 08 11 04 1C 18`: the low byte of the CHR address erased at each step of phases `$60-$7F`. A permutation of 0-31 (checked: 32 distinct values), so every byte of a 32-byte stride is erased exactly once.

regions.name: SCENE AFTER CORRIDOR 21 (bank 2 `$8836`, slot `$801B`): phase `$80` on
regions.description: `$80` or more goes to `$895C`: the ship flies off.

regions.name: SCENE AFTER CORRIDOR 21 (bank 2 `$8836`, slot `$801B`): explosions: once a phase
regions.description: Only on the pass where the fraction `$0650` is under `$40`, i.e. once a phase.

regions.name: SCENE AFTER CORRIDOR 21 (bank 2 `$8836`, slot `$801B`): an explosion
regions.description: `$05C0` := `$F0`; `$19` := `$80`, `$18` := `$B0`, the box `$3F`: `JSR $C120` (`$FB12`): a type-8 explosion near (128, 176), jittered over a 64 x 64 box. RUN: 106 explosions in the scene (they come only in phases `$40-$7F`, since phases under `$40` branch away earlier).

regions.name: SCENE AFTER CORRIDOR 21 (bank 2 `$8836`, slot `$801B`): every 4th phase a big one
regions.description: `$0638 AND 3` = 0: sound `$23`, **the new explosion's type (`$0500,Y`) := 7 (the 42-frame one)**, and the palette flash colour `$30` (white). Otherwise sound `$22` and the flash colour `$11`.

regions.name: SCENE AFTER CORRIDOR 21 (bank 2 `$8836`, slot `$801B`): the flash
regions.description: The flash colour goes into palette entries `$0189` and `$018C` and `$017F` := 3 (upload both): **the planet's colours flash with each explosion.**

regions.name: SCENE AFTER CORRIDOR 21 (bank 2 `$8836`, slot `$801B`): phase `$60-$7F`: the planet dissolves
regions.description: Only once a phase (fraction under `$40`).

regions.name: SCENE AFTER CORRIDOR 21 (bank 2 `$8836`, slot `$801B`): the dissolve
regions.description: n = phase - `$5F`; **`$88AE[n]` (a shuffled 0-31) is the low byte of a CHR address in `$1800`: a run of count `$A0` (bit 7 = increment 32, so 32 bytes at 32-byte steps) of 0**, then the same at `$1C00`; the backdrop flashes `$32` for two frames (`$0F` again). **32 steps zero every byte of CHR `$1800-$1FFF` in a shuffled order, so the planet (background tiles `$80-$FF`) falls apart.** RUN: the zero bytes in `$1800-$1FFF` go 222 -> 686 (phase `$68`) -> 1,127 (`$70`) -> 1,585 (`$78`) -> 2,036 (`$80`).

regions.name: SCENE AFTER CORRIDOR 21 (bank 2 `$8836`, slot `$801B`): go on
SCENE AFTER CORRIDOR 21 (bank 2 `$8836`, slot `$801B`): phase `$80` on: fly off
regions.description: Target 0 and acceleration 8: the ship accelerates up and out of the top (RUN: y 54 at phase `$7F`; phase `$80` began at frame 698 and the scene returned at frame 754).

regions.name: SCENE AFTER CORRIDOR 21 (bank 2 `$8836`, slot `$801B`): move, draw, objects, again
regions.description: `JSR $C08D` (move and draw; **carry = off the screen**), the flags saved, `JSR $C006` with `06 0B 80` (bank 6 `$800C`: the object loop from slot 1, so the explosions run); not off the screen: back to `$8867`.

regions.name: SCENE AFTER CORRIDOR 21 (bank 2 `$8836`, slot `$801B`): carry?
SCENE AFTER CORRIDOR 21 (bank 2 `$8836`, slot `$801B`): the end: put the screen back
regions.description: `JSR $C00F` (rendering off); **the decompressor is armed with block 2 of bank 2 into CHR `$1FE0`** (`$C042`, A = 2, Y = 2: the two tiles `$FE`, `$FF`, the solid split tile and the life-meter tile that the dissolve zeroed) and waited for; the life meter's shown value `$49` loses one if it is not 0; `JSR $C006` with `05 32 80` (bank 5 `$8033`: the HUD's shot icon). RUN: CHR `$1FE0` = `00` x 8, `FF` x 8 afterwards.

regions.name: SCENE AFTER CORRIDOR 21 (bank 2 `$8836`, slot `$801B`): return
regions.description: `RTS`.

regions.name: STATUS SCREEN CURSOR AND MARKERS (bank 2 `$8998`, slot `$801E`): the cursor's sprites
regions.description: The four corner sprites of the selection frame, OAM `$02F0-$02FF` (sprites 60-63): their tiles `$02F1/F5/F9/FD` := 0 (the frame piece of tile `$00`).

regions.name: STATUS SCREEN CURSOR AND MARKERS (bank 2 `$8998`, slot `$801E`): colour cycle and flips
regions.description: `$02F2` := (`$02F2` + 1) AND 3 is the palette, and the four corners get it with the flips `00`, `80`, `40`, `C0`: **the frame changes through all four palettes, one a frame.** RUN: attributes 0, 1, 2, 3 on consecutive frames.

regions.name: STATUS SCREEN CURSOR AND MARKERS (bank 2 `$8998`, slot `$801E`): which weapon
regions.description: `$3C` / 5 by `$C10B` (`$F9AE`): the quotient is the row, the remainder the column of the five-to-a-row grid.

regions.name: STATUS SCREEN CURSOR AND MARKERS (bank 2 `$8998`, slot `$801E`): row to y
regions.description: y := row x 16 + `$AB` for the upper pair of corners (`$02F0`, `$02F8`) and 8 more for the lower (`$02F4`, `$02FC`).

regions.name: STATUS SCREEN CURSOR AND MARKERS (bank 2 `$8998`, slot `$801E`): column to x
regions.description: x := column x 48 + 14 for the left corners and + `$1B` more for the right ones. RUN with `$3C` = 0: corners at x 14 and 41, y 171 and 179 (weapon 0, 'none', sits in the first cell).

regions.name: STATUS SCREEN CURSOR AND MARKERS (bank 2 `$8998`, slot `$801E`): hide the player's marker
STATUS SCREEN CURSOR AND MARKERS (bank 2 `$8998`, slot `$801E`): the blink counter
regions.description: `INC $14`; **bit 2 clear shows the player's position marker: tile 1, x := `$52` x 4 + `$10`, y := `$53` x 4 + `$3B`, attribute 0 - on for 4 frames, off for 4.** (`$14` is also the status screen's spare byte; here it is a free-running counter.) RUN: shown at `$14` = 2-3, 8-11, ...

regions.name: STATUS SCREEN CURSOR AND MARKERS (bank 2 `$8998`, slot `$801E`): blink the entrance markers
regions.description: Every 16th count (`$14 AND $0F` = 0) the loop **swaps the y byte of sprites 0-23 with the x byte of sprites 32-55 (`$0283 + 4i`)**: sprites 32 and over are hidden (all bytes `$F8`), so the swap hides the 24 area-entrance markers and, 16 frames later, brings them back. RUN: sprite 0 y 99 for 14 frames, `$F8` for 16, 99 again.

regions.name: STATUS SCREEN CURSOR AND MARKERS (bank 2 `$8998`, slot `$801E`): return
regions.description: `RTS`.

regions.name: THE ENDING (bank 2 `$8A69`, slot `$8021`): CONGRATULATIONS
regions.description: `JSR $C06F` with `10 21 0C 'CONGRATULATIONS['`: sixteen characters at PPU `$210C` (the last tile `$5B` is the full stop). Only the TGL game's ending shows this text.

regions.name: THE ENDING (bank 2 `$8A69`, slot `$8021`): TGL: white text
regions.description: `$0181` := `$30`, then `JMP $8AF7` (fade in, song, credits).

regions.name: THE ENDING (bank 2 `$8A69`, slot `$8021`): entry
regions.description: `LDX #$FF / TXS`: the stack is reset - **this routine never returns**. `$30` is read and cleared; **bit 1 (a TGL game) goes to `$8A3D`**, a normal game to the picture.

regions.name: THE ENDING (bank 2 `$8A69`, slot `$8021`): the picture's tiles
regions.description: `$19:$18` := `$18F0`, `LDA #4 / LDY #1 / JSR $C042`: block 4 of bank 1 (109 tiles) into CHR `$18F0` = pattern table 1 tiles `$8F-$FB`.

regions.name: THE ENDING (bank 2 `$8A69`, slot `$8021`): attributes
regions.description: Eight attribute items for nametable 0 (`$23C0-$23FF`): 16 x `00` at `$23C0`, 32 x `55` at `$23D0`, 16 x `AA` at `$23F0`, `02 23 EC A5`, `01 23 F5 A8` (a one-byte string through `$C06F`), and 4 x `FF` at `$23E0`, `$23E8`, `$23F0`.

regions.name: THE ENDING (bank 2 `$8A69`, slot `$8021`): the portrait
regions.description: A 10 x 13 block of tiles from `$8B05` (`$17:$16`, rows of the picture) to PPU `$21F1` (`$C07E` = `$D99C`, the rectangle blit; `$15` = 10 wide, `$14` = 13 high). The picture is a framed portrait (see the ending entry).

regions.description: 88 bytes from `$8B87` (22 sprites) to OAM `$0200`.

regions.description: 25 bytes from `$8BDF` to `$0180-$0198`.

regions.name: THE ENDING (bank 2 `$8A69`, slot `$8021`): fade in, song, credits
regions.description: `JSR $C0DE` (the fade in), `JSR $C030` with A = `$0F` (song `$0F`), then `JSR $C006` with `00 14 80`: **a far call to bank 0 `$8015` -> `$8915`, the credits, which never returns**.
